notes: 10x pilot (concept-maps/tenx, random arm): label and 16 sentences written by a fresh Sonnet 5.5 subagent from a packet (card + all-pole band samples); no probes. An Opus gate checked rule-level items only (8 + 8, 0 overlap with census and probe text, near misses free of the declared trigger) and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Strong activations sit on function words/prefixes (to, of, the, non-) in ethics/law/religion passages about forbidding or justifying killing, violence, lying; output promotes ' kill', ' killing', ' violence', so it looks like a prediction slot for harm words. Weak coverage by any single token, so label is a mix and the fire/quiet contrast tests the anticipation of killing/violence versus other prohibited or permitted acts.
